scope: Two zero-update probes on the frozen V3-002 reader: (1) mode start-vs-generate separability with BALANCED sampling on supported items' idle frames (fixes the DG-028 sampling defect); (2) route probe augmented with explicit structural scalars (has_source, span count, allowed-token fraction) to pre-test whether the V3-003 direction (a) existence-injection lifts r1/r2 separation. No certified weight changes.
gates: 5-fold CV with fixed folds/seed; balanced class counts reported with denominators; frozen reader digest verified; DG-028's skewed mode result kept as-is (not overwritten).

decision_inputs.mode_probe: if balanced start recall is high, the mode head failure is also a readout/optimization issue; if low, mode needs its own structural input
decision_inputs.route_structural_probe: if r2 recall with structural scalars rises materially (>=0.7), V3-003 direction (a) is evidence-supported; otherwise direction (b)/feature redesign dominates

stop: Report both results as measured; no gate relaxation; no budget consumption.
